observation.command: cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl -o bad-index.html && CSRF=$(grep -oE 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' bad-index.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -c badcookie.txt -b badcookie.txt -D bad-headers.txt -o bad-after.html -X POST http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "Step=Login" --data-urlencode "AccountType=agent" --data-urlencode "Language=en" --data-urlencode "Login=admin" --data-urlencode "Password=wrongpassword123" && head -1 bad-headers.txt; grep -c QISUTU_SESSION bad-headers.txt; grep -oiE '(Invalid|Wrong|ungültig|falsch)[^<]{0,50}' bad-after.html | head -3
